title: Payments Recognised Against What Was Owed on a Terminated Ridgecrest Advantage Enrollment
content:
The payments recognised against the plan premium reckoned as owed when a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan coverage ended are taken from the plan premium payments standing on the premium account.

| Billing cadence on the enrollment | Plan premium payments standing on the premium account | The payments recognised |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Quarterly | At least 2 | Every plan premium payment posted on the account in the contract year |
| Monthly | At least 2 | The plan premium payments posted on the account in the last 3 months |
| Quarterly or monthly | Fewer than 2 | The most recent plan premium payment standing on the premium account |

With 0 or 1 plan premium payment standing on the premium account the cadence makes no difference, and the most recent payment is the whole of what is recognised. Once at least 2 payments stand there, a quarterly cadence takes in every payment of the contract year while a monthly cadence takes in only those posted inside the last 3 months.

*A terminated enrollment billed monthly whose premium account carries plan premium payments of 89.30 USD posted this month, 89.30 USD posted two months ago and 89.30 USD posted six months ago.* At least 2 payments stand there and the cadence is monthly, so the payments recognised are the two inside the last 3 months, together 178.60 USD.
